generators.carrier: Inscription carrier with declared observation family O_n, each observation having its own codomain

relations.statement: x ≈ₙ y iff for all o in O_n, o(x) = o(y), with equality in the codomain of o
relations.hypotheses: A declared carrier and a declared family O_n of observations on it

relations.statement: If O_n is empty then x ≈ₙ y for all x y, in particular <a> ≈ₙ <ab>

lemmas.statement: For empty O_n, every pair is equivalent
lemmas.lean_skeleton: theorem vacuous_equiv {α : Type} {ι : Type} (cod : ι → Type) (O : ∀ i : ι, α → cod i) (hE : IsEmpty ι) (x y : α) : ∀ i : ι, O i x = O i y := fun i => (hE.false i).elim

lemmas.statement: x = y implies x ≈ₙ y for any O_n
lemmas.lean_skeleton: theorem equiv_of_eq {α : Type} {ι : Type} (cod : ι → Type) (O : ∀ i : ι, α → cod i) (x y : α) (h : x = y) : ∀ i : ι, O i x = O i y := fun i => by rw [h]

near_misses.rejecting_invariant: With empty O_n, <a> ≈ₙ <ab> but the strings differ; equivalence is regime-relative, not string equality

near_misses.claim: The regime has an internal equality operator deciding ≈ₙ
near_misses.rejecting_invariant: Comparison happens in the metatheory in each codomain; no equality operator is installed inside the regime
